scope: Exactly one bounded observation design at existing six cycle-marker/ACK boundaries; no actor, starter, codefreeze or next-run approval.
conclusion: Existing unprivileged interfaces can separate cgroup aggregate file/shmem categories and identify private tmpfs allocation plus known-process shared-mapping residence. They cannot prove an exact per-inode memcg-charge split or identify the owner of an earlier native peak.

Recommend only the bounded census below if endpoint allocation/residence evidence is a useful separately declared objective. If exact clone/JIT/PG charge ownership remains mandatory, this source design does not satisfy it and alone does not justify another native run.
No product fix, resource reserve, plateau, W45/projection activation, allocator cause or additional saving follows from these sources.

sourceLocations.finding: mount() reads /proc/self/mountinfo in worker namespace; currently returns fs/options, discarding mountID and dev/root identity.
snapshot reads entire parent memory.stat/current/peak/events and cpu. No inode/charge correlation.
proc_diagnostic only attempts known child status+io; OSError becomes readable:false/errorType, not zero. It does not read smaps/maps/PFN and its success is not mandatory for overall PASS.
Mandatory UID1000, exact adopted parent inode, private 0::/ cgroup view, readonly original, persistent clone disk, /ram tmpfs256MiB and JITlib tmpfs.
JIT restored under /ram/jit-root, then three confined lib symlinks created in separate PGlib tmpfs.
Known pg.pid is directly owned Popen postmaster; shared_buffers128MB/work_mem4MB remain explicit. shared_memory_type/dynamic_shared_memory_type/huge_pages_status are not forced here.

Exactly six existing marker gates. Native snapshot, known Node/postmaster/PostgREST status+io, existing small metrics SQL, observation persistence, then ACK. Same unchanged30s Node wall includes observer work.

Fresh own disk bind; readonly runtime/source/tools; private cgroupns/default private PID; UID1000/cap-dropALL/no-new-privileges/networknone. Three private tmpfs mounts: /ram256MiB, PGLib1MiB, /dev/shm16MiB. Complete bind/tmpfs policy checked.
Root-side native timeline samples cgroup counters and trims after220 entries. It supplies no file identity/charge ownership and is not a complete uniform curve.
Parent current/peak/event/cpu/io with final empty-group coverage; no pagecache/inode classification.

readabilityMatrix.interface: pagemap/PFN+kpagecgroup, BPF/perf or privileged kernel ownership instrumentation
readabilityMatrix.nativeWorker: No qualified capability/interface exists in current cap-dropALL runtime. Official Linux v6.12 pagemap.rst29-32 says PFNs require CAP_SYS_ADMIN and are zeroed without it;83-85 documents kpagecgroup PFN->memcg inode when CONFIG_MEMCG. This is source semantics, not current host-version/config/access proof. No PFN read or new capability is proposed.
readabilityMatrix.meaning: The documented page->PFN->memcg-inode path needs qualified permissions/config and mapped-page coverage. It does not by itself enumerate unmapped clone pagecache. Exact owner evidence remains outside current bounded interfaces.

accountingRules.rule: file already includes tmpfs/shared memory; shmem is a subset. Never add file+shmem.
file_mapped/dirty/writeback and LRU fields are overlapping detail/state counters, not additive disjoint owners.

Charge belongs to the instantiating cgroup and can differ from current users; migration does not transfer existing charge. Shared readers do not each own a copy of the charge. No fadvise/cache eviction may be used to manufacture ownership.

974 original JIT regular files/176281648 logicalB/178290688 planned pageB restored freshly inside metered group; actualRegularAllocatedBytes saved. These are allocation/provenance facts, not additional memory to add to cgroup.shmem. Three PGlib symlinks target the same /ram data; do not count a second JIT copy.

Main PG shared buffers may use anonymous shared mmap or SysV; dynamic shared memory may use POSIX/SysV/disk-backed mmap. Existing selected catalog omits actual shared_memory_type/dynamic_shared_memory_type/huge_pages_status. Do not force a method or label all PGshmem as /dev/shm, all anonymous shared VMAs as exact shared_buffers, or configured128MB as actual resident bytes.

smaps/RSS/PSS observes mapped residence and proportions. It omits unmapped buffered pagecache, does not expose memcg owner, and may alias physical pages. Never sum PGpostmaster/backend RSS or per-VMA RSS into group charge; even within one process alias mappings need no-add qualification.

statvfs used blocks and st_blocks count allocation at filesystem/inode scope. They are not a precise resident/charge partition. No fs allocation or mapping value is subtracted to assert an exact PGshared residual.

oneMinimalCandidateContract.name: SIX_EXISTING_BOUNDARY_IDENTITY_ALLOCATION_RESIDENCE_CENSUS
oneMinimalCandidateContract.placement: Inside existing observe_cycle, after exact marker validation and before existing cycle-metrics SQL/ACK; one attached object in existing CYCLE_n.OBSERVATION, n1..6, no extra Auth/SQL/RPC/marker/Node operation.
oneRecordContains: Sequence/round/edge; UTC+monotonic before/after; parent inode; current/peak/file/shmem/anon/kernel and swap.current before/after. Sequential, non-atomic, observer-included.

Known Popen postmaster PID, UID, starttime ticks before/after; worker/postmaster mount/PID/cgroup namespace identity and private relative cgroup membership. Reject identity drift; no host PID or all-proc walk.

Four fixed root identities: clonePGDATA and three tmpfs roots. For tmpfs only: mountID, major/minor/st_dev/rootinode, f_frsize/f_blocks/f_bfree/f_bavail, derived allocatedFilesystemBytes. Dedupe filesystem identity; preserve exact expected256/1/16MiB mount limits. No directory traversal or payload opens.
Existing in-memory JIT report scalar pin/regularFiles/logicalBytes/plannedPageBytes/actualRegularAllocatedBytes only. /ram FS total is not added to JIT metadata; PGlib symlinks are aliases.

Streaming only known postmaster smaps, retaining at most8 shared-VMA candidate summaries: namespace+dev/inode/offset/range identity, shared permission, bounded origin class, size/Rss/Pss/Shared/Private/Swap/hugetlb scalars. Preserve each mapping separately; do not sum into a charge. Anonymous/SysV/unknown forms remain candidates, not proven main-PGshared ownership.
oneMinimalCandidateContract.capQualification: Design ceilings, not yet executable or runtime-qualified. Stream bounded inputs, do not retain raw smaps/mountinfo/full paths. Optional capture denial/oversize/extra map=>bounded UNKNOWN code and incomplete diagnostic; never silently truncate into COMPLETE or invent zero. Safety identity drift rejects diagnostic acceptance.
oneMinimalCandidateContract.nonAtomicity: Read memory.peak first and last of record, preserve observation times. Memory.stat counters can lag/update while read. Any intra-record peak rise includes observer allocations/page-table walks/output; no causality. Saving the record after its end also has overhead.
oneMinimalCandidateContract.outputPersistence: Attach only to existing worker observation; no new standalone files, stdout duplication or Node payload. Still enforce unchanged total4MiB evidence/256KiB capture and same Node30s deadline. No broad budget raise.
